summary: Disconnected OCI values (values-oci.yaml): clusterRouterBase, pluginMode oci, imageTagInfo, imageRegistry (host only), optional ociPluginImage for non-standard mirror paths, backstage.image repository rhdh/rhdh-hub-rhel9 tag 1.8 (the chart pins digests that podman tag/push loses), ansible.rhaap.checkSSL, and the rhaap catalog orgs.
questions: What is ociPluginImage in the portal chart?
Portal image digest not found after mirroring with podman
Example values-oci.yaml for an air-gapped portal
Why override the backstage image tag in a disconnected install?

answer_card.title: Air-gapped values for OCI plug-in delivery
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
redhat-developer-hub:
  global:
    clusterRouterBase: <your_cluster_router_base>
    pluginMode: oci
    imageTagInfo: "<plugin-version>"
    imageRegistry: "<disconnected_registry_url>"   # host only
    # ociPluginImage: "<registry>/custom-path/automation-portal"  # non-standard mirror path
  upstream:
    backstage:
      image:            # chart pins SHA256 digests; podman tag/push loses them
        repository: rhdh/rhdh-hub-rhel9
        tag: "1.8"
      appConfig:
        ansible:
          rhaap:
            checkSSL: true
        catalog:
          providers:
            rhaap:
              '{{- include "catalog.providers.env" . }}':
                orgs: "<your-aap-organization-name>"
```
